thread:
Ellen (partnerships): TL;DR: request to create a "compatibility exception lane" for partners who cannot upgrade SDKs quickly (hardware vendors, air-gapped SIs). Goal: formal process + telemetry + marketplace gating. Need owners + quick template.
Vik (eng): sounds useful. Suggest we formalize three lanes: shim-bridge (server-side translation), long-term-support (LTS) builds, and portal-mint (partner-admin tokens). Each lane has SLA and sunset policy.
June (devex): I can own shim-bridge artifacts. Plan: publish `@redwood/compat-bridge` npm + `redwood-compat-bridge` pypi with a Helm chart. Shims will add header `X-RW-Compat: bridge` and emit deprecation logs. ETA prototype: May 2.
Rosa (product): product + partnerships will define eligibility criteria for exception lanes: >1yr hardware lifecycle, regulated deployments, marketplace partners with >$X revenue. We'll make a short intake form and a partner-runbook template.
Theo (platform): gateway implications: we'll accept shimmed traffic but tag it so SRE can route differently. Plan canary: enable static translation in eu-west first. Also add metric `compat_bridge_traffic_pct`. Ops runbook RNW-ex-101 created.
Maya (legal): we'll need a lightweight addendum (consent snippet) for marketplace vendors that opt-into LTS or exception lanes. I'll draft a one-paragraph addendum permitting a longer compatibility window and liability notes.
MarketBot: @Ellen created issue RNW-7007 "Compatibility exception lanes + marketplace gating" https://issues.redwood.ai/RNW-7007
Ellen (partnerships): action items: Partnerships draft intake form + escalation matrix by Apr 18. Devex to publish shim prototype May 2. Platform canary May 9. Legal addendum by Apr 12. Product to publish eligibility + dashboard filters Apr 20.
Vik (eng): technical notes: shims will do header translation, minor payload transforms, and optionally serve gRPC->REST adaptors for legacy connectors. We'll expose a `compat-mode` healthcheck so partners can verify behavior.
June (devex): example shim usage (JS): `const compat = require('@redwood/compat-bridge'); app.post('/rw', compat({bridge:true}), handler)` also provide a Docker image and K8s chart for on-prem partners. We'll include a smoke-test script that hits partner endpoints and validates responses.
Rosa (product): marketplace UI changes: add "Compat Lane" badge on vendor listings and a filter in the vendor dashboard. Vendors opting in appear in a special listing and get extended timeline metadata.
Theo (platform): telemetry: emit `compat_exception_granted` event and daily export of vendors on exception lanes. We'll also add alerts if >5% of production traffic is shimmed for a given partner.
Maya (legal): special note: EU data residency partners may require the shim to be deployed in-region. We'll include that in the addendum and loop compliance.
Ellen (partnerships): comms plan: first outreach to top 50 partners with potential need by Apr 22. Partners fill intake form; partnerships evaluates and approves by Apr 30. Public docs + portal UI May 6.
Vik (eng): lifecycle policy: exception lanes are reviewed every 6 months; automatic reminders sent to partner admins at 60/30/14 days before scheduled end. If partner wants extension, file a case and legal+partnerships review.
June (devex): I'll publish quickstart + migration checklist and run a partners-only office hours on May 10. Also will add a tiny C helper for edge devices that can't run node/python.
Rosa (product): owners: partnerships=Ellen, devex=June, platform=Theo, eng=Vik, legal=Maya, product=Rosa. Please update RNW-7007 with owners and ETA.
Ellen (partnerships): thanks all — this should reduce surprise breakages and make marketplace vetting clearer. I'll start the intake form draft now. :thumbsup:
All: :thumbsup:
